spanish: Y la liebre, porque levantadora rumia ella, y pezuña no la partió; impura ella a ustedes.
grammarChanges: arnévet → liebre (translated transliterated common noun into Spanish)
subiente → levantadora (restored Hiphil causative stem force on the participle instead of simple intransitive rising)
cud → rumia (translated English noun into Spanish, same open sense as the source noun)
pezuña no partió → pezuña no la partió (added object clitic so the animal, not the hoof, remains subject of the Hiphil perfect)
